dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: electrical release during start-up after maintenance on P-3223

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on P-3223 and M-3223 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically identifying every energy source for a task. P-3223 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 28 March 2018 an incident occurred on P-3223 and M-3223 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
